name: Interactive Data Explorer

props.text: Read-only CSV/TSV, active XLSX sheet and SQLite tables. First 5000 rows / 60 columns; export filtered data separately.

events.Change:
# Handle this designer control.
data_open(self, True)

events.Click:
# Handle this designer control.
self.page = 0
data_refresh(self)

# Sort the selected column ascending.
data_refresh(self, False)

# Handle this designer control.
data_refresh(self, True)

startup:
# Open no source automatically; the built-in sample makes filter/chart behavior visible.
self.source = None
self.headers = ['Item','Quantity','Price']
self.rows = [['Books','12','8.5'],['Pens','35','1.2'],['Folders','18','3.0']]
self.visible = []
self.truncated = False
self.page = 0
self.descending = False
self.Column.configure(values=self.headers)
self.Column.set('Quantity')
self.Table.configure(state='disabled')
self.Grid.configure(columns=['c0','c1','c2'],show='headings')
for i,label in enumerate(self.headers):
    self.Grid.heading('c'+str(i),text=label)
    self.Grid.column('c'+str(i),width=140,minwidth=80,stretch=False)
# Scrollbars are attached to the editable designer Treeview.
self.data_vscroll = ttk.Scrollbar(self.Form1,orient='vertical',command=self.Grid.yview)
self.data_vscroll.place(x=956,y=160,width=18,height=340)
self.data_hscroll = ttk.Scrollbar(self.Form1,orient='horizontal',command=self.Grid.xview)
self.data_hscroll.place(x=20,y=500,width=935,height=18)
self.Grid.configure(yscrollcommand=self.data_vscroll.set,xscrollcommand=self.data_hscroll.set)
data_refresh(self)
self.Form1.deiconify()
